name: MemoTrap
description: MemoTrap (Memorization Trap) is a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs follow instructions that conflict with memorized patterns. Tasks include completing common proverbs/phrases with a different ending, anti-natural-language-inference, and anti-few-shot-learning. Tests instruction-following vs. learned memorization.
typical_sota_score: ~60-75% (LLMs often fail to follow instructions against memorized patterns)
reputation: Tests instruction-following vs. memorization conflict in LLMs; published at ACL 2023; exposes a key failure mode in instruction-tuned models
notes: Published at ACL 2023 findings. Tests whether instruction-tuned LLMs follow explicit instructions when they conflict with memorized completions. Three sub-tasks: (1) completing proverbs with wrong letters, (2) anti-NLI (predict opposite of natural inference), (3) anti-few-shot (ignore demonstrated pattern). Highlights tension between instruction following and pretraining memorization.
